step.action: Walk one edge of 🌐 Dance_Floor with 🌐 Landscape_Rakes and 📦 MOOP_Buckets.
Pull each rake lightly through the playa in a straight pass to the opposite edge.
Put every exposed piece of MOOP in 📦 MOOP_Buckets.
Repeat overlapping straight passes until the entire dance floor has been raked.
Rake down ridges or piles created by the passes.

passWhen.criterion: The entire dance floor has been covered by overlapping rake passes.
No rake ridge or playa pile remains.
